# Medium fixture: multi-stage analog block

Suggested circuit: a Eurorack VCA core, exponential converter, or
multi-stage active filter. 15-30 components, mix of discrete transistors
and op-amps, at least one feedback loop.

The medium fixture is where the placer choice starts to matter. ELK Layered
should produce something legible; HOLA should produce something noticeably
more compact and symmetric.
